subject: Privileged access review + SSO/SCIM evidence request
messages:
From: Jane Cooper <jane.cooper@clientcorp.com>
To: security@redwoodinference.com; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ClientCorp: IAM evidence request for security review

Hi team,

As part of our quarterly SIG review, we need a narrow set of artifacts to close out the Access Control section. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday 7/2?

- SCIM delta logs covering 6/15–6/29 (CSV or NDJSON) showing user provisioning/deprovisioning and group membership changes
- A small set of SAML assertion samples for inbound SSO (redwood->ClientCorp) showing NameID, attributes, and signature headers
- Current RBAC role matrix (who has what role, and which privileges are scoped to each role)
- A short justification doc for privileged (owner/admin) access to production services (who, why, approval chain)

If you already have a consolidated zip or a Drive folder, a link is fine. Otherwise, attach the files to this thread. Happy to take preliminary pieces earlier.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Cooper
Security Operations, ClientCorp
security@clientcorp.com

Thanks Jane — we'll get this over. Quick plan:

- Jasmine will pull the SCIM deltas and SAML assertion samples.
- Naomi will export the RBAC matrix from the console and add role descriptions.
- I'll draft the privileged access justification and include an approval log.

Target: consolidate into a single Drive folder and send a zip by end of day Friday 2027-07-02. If any item will run late we'll call it out by Thursday 7/1.

Markus — fyi in case we need exec sign-off for privileged access notes.

Priyom

Working on it — quick notes from infra: SCIM delta endpoint kept a rolling 30-day export; I backfilled the 6/15–6/29 window and attached a CSV extract (see file: scim_delta_20270629.csv).

SAML: I pulled three assertion samples from the staging assertion log (redacted PII) and included a small text file with the raw assertions and header context (saml_assertion_samples.txt). The assertions include the NameID and attributes we normally send (email, groups, role).

I'll sanitize and upload to Drive. If ClientCorp needs full raw logs (non-redacted) we should do that over an encrypted transfer.

Jasmine

Attaching RBAC export and privileged access justification.

- rbac_role_matrix_v3.xlsx (tabs: Roles, Privileges, Members, ApprovalHistory) — includes mapping from console role ids to human-readable names.

Priyom / team — received, thank you.

I reviewed the Drive folder and the attached files (SCIM CSV + SAML samples + RBAC matrix + privileged doc). This is sufficient for the SIG Access Controls checklist. A couple minor asks:

- Can you confirm the retention policy that generated the SCIM deltas (how long do you keep reconciliation logs)?
- For SAML samples, please include one assertion that contains the email attribute (we saw two with groups only).

If you can drop those two items into the same folder by EOD Monday 7/5 that would be ideal. Otherwise this closes for the current cadence — thanks for the fast turnaround.

Best,
Jane
Security Operations, ClientCorp
